summary: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode
description: The Bug: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. This issue also doesn t appear to happen all of the time. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft snapshot version 24w33a.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Set the graphics settings to "Fabulous" via Options -> Video Settings.
4. Switch to Spectator mode using `/gamemode spectator`.
5. Open your inventory by clicking on the inventory icon (little chest).
6. Observe that the game crashes when you open the inventory while in Spectator mode.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode. This issue does not occur consistently, and a crash report has been attached for reference. The stack trace indicates a `NullPointerException` during screen rendering related to the inventory operation. To reproduce this bug, open your inventory while in spectator mode with Fabulous graphics settings enabled. Observed behavior includes the game crashing upon attempting to access the inventory. The expected behavior is that the game should not crash and allow players to view their inventory without issues. Additional testing has shown that the crash does not occur in all scenarios, suggesting a potential dependency on specific conditions or configurations. This bug may be related to previously reported issues such as "MC-191431" and "MC-275566."
Expected Behavior: When opening the inventory while in spectator mode, the game should not crash. Instead, the inventory interface should display normally without any disruptions or errors, allowing the player to interact with items as expected. This behavior should be consistent regardless of the graphics settings used.
